Job Summary: The successful candidate will be responsible for driving commercial excellence by leading business improvement initiatives, optimizing processes and systems, strengthening governance, and enabling performance-based decision-making. Acting as a trusted partner to Commercial Leadership, the role ensures the effective execution of strategic priorities while improving operational efficiency, commercial performance, and cross-functional collaboration. Key Responsibilities: Lead the development, review, and continuous improvement of commercial processes, policies, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, effectiveness, governance, and consistency across commercial operations. Drive the optimization and adoption of commercial systems, tools, and technologies. Establish and maintain appropriate controls to ensure data integrity, compliance, and process discipline. Partner with key stakeholders to simplify workflows and improve the overall user experience within commercial systems Lead commercial transformation initiatives and business improvement projects from conception through implementation. Develop project plans, coordinate resources, manage timelines, and monitor progress against established objectives. Design and maintain reporting frameworks, dashboards, scorecards, and performance review processes. Deliver actionable insights that support growth in revenue, profitability, distribution, customer engagement, and sales execution. Monitor key commercial performance indicators, identifying trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement. Serve as a key liaison between Commercial, Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, IT, Customer Service, and other business functions. Coordinate cross-functional initiatives to improve execution of commercial priorities. Facilitate issue identification, root cause analysis, and resolution of process and system-related challenges Support Commercial Leadership in the execution of strategic priorities and operational initiatives. Establish governance frameworks that improve accountability, visibility, and decision-making. Position Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Finance, Economics, Analytics, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related discipline. Certification in project management, Lean Six Sigma, continuous improvement, change management, or a related discipline is desirable. Three to five years (3-5) of progressive experience in commercial operations, business performance, sales operations, business analysis, finance business partnering, or a related field. Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional projects, process improvement initiatives, and organizational change. Strong working knowledge of commercial systems, reporting tools, data visualization, and business intelligence platforms. Proven ability to translate data into commercial insight, facilitate decisions, influence senior stakeholders, and deliver outcomes across multiple functions. Experience in commercial, sales, customer, or distribution environments is preferred Ref: CBPTcccc Apply Now
